name: 葉宗軒
objective:
本課程為非資訊科系學生設計的人工智慧與程式語言入門課程，目標是培養學生對數位工具的掌握與運用能力。
課程從程式設計的基礎邏輯出發，並融入生成式 AI 的操作與應用，帶領學生熟悉當前具代表性的 AI 工具，培養運用生成式 AI 進行創作與問題解決的實務能力。
課程同時著重當代美學的探索與思辨，帶領學生觀察 AI 科技如何影響當代文創產業的樣貌，並反思創作者在這個新技術浪潮中的角色與定位。透過理論理解與實作演練並重的課程設計，學生將能具體體會 AI 新科技對產業發展帶來的現況與挑戰，並進一步思考自己在未來 AI 時代中，作為文發人所需具備的能力與準備方向。

This course introduces artificial intelligence and programming to students outside information science, aiming to cultivate their command and application of digital tools. Starting from the fundamental logic of programming, the course incorporates the operation and application of generative AI, guiding students to become familiar with today's leading AI tools and develop hands-on capabilities to use generative AI for creative work and problem-solving.
The course also emphasizes exploration and critical reflection on contemporary aesthetics, leading students to observe how AI technology is reshaping the cultural and creative industries, and to reflect on the creator's role and position amid this new technological wave. Through a curriculum that balances conceptual understanding with hands-on practice, students will gain a concrete sense of the current state and challenges AI brings to industry development, and further consider the capabilities and preparation they will need as cultural and creative practitioners in the coming AI era.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 01 課程架構與練習 Course Structure and Exercises
Week 02 科技與藝術的關係 Technology and Art: A Historical Relationship
Week 03 設計預言 Design Speculation / Design Speculative Practice
Week 04 程式實作 1 (程式基礎) Programming Practice 1: Fundamentals
Week 05 程式實作 2 (實作教學) Programming Practice 2: Hands-on Techniques
Week 06 生成式 AI 基礎原理 Fundamentals of Generative AI
Week 07 圖像生成模型 Image Generation Models
Week 08 期中企劃發表 Midterm Project Presentation
Week 09 當代生成式 AI 藝術脈絡 Contemporary Generative AI Art Discourse
Week 10 AI 倫理與創作者定位 AI Ethics and the Creator's Position
Week 11 期末專題發想工作坊：如何用 AI 說故事 Storytelling with AI
Week 12 AI 創作實作 1 AI Creative Practice 1
Week 13 AI 創作實作 2 AI Creative Practice 2
Week 14 程式工具串接實作 Tool Integration Practice
Week 15 期末專題工作坊 Final Project Workshop
Week 16 期末發表與反思座談 Final Presentation and Reflection
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Week 17 彈性學習：AI 美學趨勢研究與資料採集 Flexible Learning: AI Aesthetics Trend Research and Case Gathering：學生利用彈性週自主檢索、篩選當代 AI 藝術與美學趨勢之案例與資料。

Week 18 彈性學習：AI 美學趨勢研究報告發表與交流 Flexible Learning: AI Aesthetics Trend Research Presentation and Exchange
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          整合研究發現與個人創作反思，完成書面報告並於課堂進行簡短分享，展現獨立研究與批判思考能力。
        
      

      
        評量比例

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
